other_conditions: Must hold a regular position in a recognized Indian academic or research organization
Must possess a Ph.D. in Science, Engineering, or Medicine
Must not be receiving any other fellowship from a Government of India scheme
Must be active in frontier areas of science and engineering with outstanding contributions such as publications, patents, peer recognition, or awards
The host organization must undertake financial and management responsibilities for the project throughout the five‑year term
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹25,000 in addition to the applicant’s salary for up to five years, with project funding considered by SERB.
